self = <test_wp043_live_capture.WP043LiveCaptureTests testMethod=test_recursive_recovery_precheck_rejects_a_fleeting_external_or_mixed_blocker>
def test_recursive_recovery_precheck_rejects_a_fleeting_external_or_mixed_blocker(self): for phase in ("navigation-before-enter", "capture-before-grab", "capture-after-grab"): for change in ("external-recursive-precheck", "mixed-recursive-precheck"): with self.subTest(phase=phase, change=change): evidence, backend = self._transient_recovery_race(phase, "owned", change) self.assertEqual(backend.recursive_blocker_observations, 1) self.assertEqual(backend.operations.count("close-owned-transient"), 1) > self.assertEqual(evidence["status"], "failed") E AssertionError: 'independent-live-window-captured' != 'failed' E - independent-live-window-captured E + failed
